final.name: Dark or taboo content delivered flatly
final.audit_justification: Requires the craft technique of flat, deadpan delivery of dark material, not merely the presence of dark content, which is a genuine comic-execution judgment.

final.name: Phonetic pun or wordplay density
final.audit_justification: Measures only the presence/amount of a wordplay device and explicitly disclaims judging its cleverness, though genuine punning ability could also reflect broader verbal skill.

final.name: Electoral and news-cycle political referents
final.audit_justification: A pure count of political-referent presence that explicitly disclaims judging timeliness, pointedness, or quality, i.e. a subject-matter topic marker.
final.upstream_parent: submission timing relative to the news cycle at the moment of the contest round

final.name: Named external media or cultural-property reference
final.audit_justification: Counts sheer presence of a named external reference while explicitly disclaiming whether it is apt or well-chosen, a topic-marker fingerprint rather than craft.

final.name: Sustained character voice appropriate to a reimagined role
final.audit_justification: Measures sustained execution of a committed persona without breaking voice, a recognized comic-writing craft skill.

final.name: Caption brevity / word count
final.audit_justification: A pure word-count/length metric that explicitly disallows judging whether the length helps or hurts, though the editing discipline behind brevity can also produce sharper writing.

final.name: Cultural allusion repurposing
final.audit_justification: Distinguishes genuine creative reworking of an allusion from merely naming or quoting it, a real transformative-craft judgment.

final.name: Deadpan audacity
final.audit_justification: Directly evaluates calm, matter-of-fact delivery of an absurd premise as a comic-craft device, versus overexplaining.

final.name: Specific numeric or quantitative detail
final.audit_justification: Judges whether a number functions as the structural centerpiece of the joke, a compositional property, not merely its presence.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction explicitly forbids judging whether the chosen number is funny, so it scores the presence and structural centrality of a numeric device rather than any evidence that the caption lands; an arbitrary number can be the central device of a dead joke and still score 10. Specificity is nonetheless a real comedic craft habit, so the same upstream disposition plausibly produces genuinely better entries.

final.name: Named cultural allusions
final.audit_justification: Counts the amount of allusive/reference material present while explicitly disclaiming whether the allusion is apt, a topic marker.

final.name: Distinctive speaker voice
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether diction actually conveys a specific persona or relationship that could not be voiced neutrally, a genuine craft quality.

final.name: Ethical or social reversal
final.audit_justification: Rewards exposing a contradiction or hypocrisy through a concise reversal versus a generic opinion, a substantive insight/craft trait.

final.name: Joke requires an ironic/sarcastic reversal
final.audit_justification: Evaluates whether an ironic reversal structurally carries the entire joke, a core comic-mechanism craft judgment.

final.name: Punctuation-driven timing
final.audit_justification: Requires that punctuation or spacing produce a materially different reading or comic pause, an effect-based craft judgment rather than mere presence.

final.name: Institutional register
final.audit_justification: Measures sheer amount of institutional/bureaucratic vocabulary while explicitly disclaiming sophistication or effectiveness, a register/topic marker.

final.name: Idiom literalization
final.audit_justification: Distinguishes fresh, situational reinterpretation of an idiom from conventional use, a genuine transformative-craft judgment.

final.name: Era-dating situational idiom and euphemism
final.audit_justification: Flags period-specific idiom that dates the item to a particular era while explicitly disclaiming freshness or humor, a temporal tell.
final.upstream_parent: the calendar date of the contest round (corpus vintage)

final.name: Elliptical inference
final.audit_justification: Judges whether an omission produces one coherent, recoverable inference versus incoherence, a compositional craft skill.

final.name: Clashing interpretive frames
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether two incompatible domains or interpretations collide coherently, a substantive craft accomplishment versus incoherent juxtaposition.

final.name: Taboo/body vocabulary
final.audit_justification: Counts the amount of taboo/body-related subject matter present while explicitly disclaiming whether it improves the caption, a topic marker.

final.name: Conversational plausibility
final.audit_justification: Evaluates whether the line reads as a naturally motivated exchange with clear pragmatic intent versus forced or contextless, a genuine writing-craft property.

final.name: Oddly precise number anchors the joke
final.audit_justification: Requires the number to be unusually precise and to intensify the comic point, tying it to comedic effect rather than mere numeric presence.

final.name: Temporal anchoring
final.audit_justification: Counts amount of temporal-reference language while explicitly disclaiming whether the timing makes the caption effective, a temporal-tell topic marker.

final.name: Punchline compression
final.audit_justification: Directly measures economical, no-filler construction where every word contributes, a core compositional craft trait.

final.name: Clash of incongruous registers in one line
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether two clearly mismatched registers are yoked together coherently within one line, a substantive craft technique.
